title: The useEffect Hook
description: Learn how to perform side effects in functional components.

data.text: **useEffect** is the hook for performing side effects in functional components. Side effects include data fetching, subscriptions, timers, and manually changing the DOM.
useEffect runs after every render by default. You can control when it runs by providing a dependency array.

data.title: useEffect Syntax

items: **Data fetching**: Load data when component mounts

data.title: Document Title
Stale Closures
data.text: Be careful with closures in useEffect. If you reference state or props, include them in the dependency array to avoid stale values.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Empty dependency array runs once on mount
Include all referenced values in dependencies
useEffect handles side effects in functional components
data.takeaway: useEffect is essential for side effects. Let's learn about cleanup.
